build_check.description: index.html and game_logic.js exist, a canvas/WebGL renderer is present, and no disallowed heavy runtime asset references are used.

requirements.description: Allow pointer-based tower placement on a voxel grid with ghost previews, range indicators, cost checks, smoke particles, and a landing bounce. Score 0 if the system is absent, decorative, or cannot be completed through player input. Score 1 requires the full interaction and its success/failure consequences to be observable in one playable flow.

Move enemies with A* pathfinding from spawn to base, recalculating legal routes after placement and rejecting constructions that fully block the path. Score 0 if the system is absent, decorative, or cannot be completed through player input. Score 1 requires the full interaction and its success/failure consequences to be observable in one playable flow.

Implement at least three tower types with distinct targeting, laser or projectile behavior, damage roles, cooldowns, and upgrade branches. Score 0 if the system is absent, decorative, or cannot be completed through player input. Score 1 requires the full interaction and its success/failure consequences to be observable in one playable flow.

Run multiple waves with several enemy types, escalating stats, rewards, base health, victory, defeat, pause, and speed controls. Score 0 if this content is missing or differs only through labels or color swaps. Score 1 requires functionally distinct content that changes the player's decisions.

Add destructible or changing terrain, branching lanes, and tactical tiles that influence range, speed, or damage. Score 0 if this content is missing or differs only through labels or color swaps. Score 1 requires functionally distinct content that changes the player's decisions.

Create volumetric-looking hit and death explosions, readable health feedback, economy UI, and a complete results/retry flow. Score 0 if this content is missing or differs only through labels or color swaps. Score 1 requires functionally distinct content that changes the player's decisions.

New islands introduce route constraints, tower synergies, enemy resistances, and persistent unlock choices across a short campaign. Score 0 if this content is missing or differs only through labels or color swaps. Score 1 requires functionally distinct content that changes the player's decisions.

The HUD clearly communicates current objective, critical resources, selected target or mode, progress, and danger states in stable regions. Score 0 if essential information or feedback is missing, unreadable, overlapping, or disconnected from the game state at 1280x720.

Every important player action has immediate, distinguishable feedback for valid input, invalid input, success, damage or failure, and state change. Score 0 if essential information or feedback is missing, unreadable, overlapping, or disconnected from the game state at 1280x720.

The full loop is connected: styled title and start flow, playable core systems, progression or escalation, final success/failure state, and retry or return navigation all work without reloading the page. Score 0 if essential information or feedback is missing, unreadable, overlapping, or disconnected from the game state at 1280x720.

The project has a coherent authored art direction: A polished pastel voxel diorama with lush terrain, toy-like towers and enemies, crisp laser lines, chunky smoke, and colorful volumetric explosions. Score 0 if the presentation is dominated by default controls, unlit primitives, inconsistent materials, or abrupt unanimated state changes. Full credit may be earned with runtime-authored procedural textures, layered materials, deliberate multi-light rigs, particles, synthesized audio, or post-processing; external asset files are not required.

The 3D environment has deliberate composition, lighting, material contrast, depth cues, and themed landmarks rather than an empty floor with scattered objects. Score 0 if the presentation is dominated by default controls, unlit primitives, inconsistent materials, or abrupt unanimated state changes.

Primary interactive actors, machines, targets, hazards, and UI symbols have readable silhouettes and visibly different functional states. Score 0 if the presentation is dominated by default controls, unlit primitives, inconsistent materials, or abrupt unanimated state changes.

Movement, impacts, transitions, alerts, completion moments, and interface changes use smooth multi-frame animation, particles, camera treatment, or audio-reactive motion. Score 0 if the presentation is dominated by default controls, unlit primitives, inconsistent materials, or abrupt unanimated state changes.
